import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import OrdinalEncoder
import os
import gc

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Suppress warning messages
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.width", None)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Feature engineering - add explicit interaction features
print("Creating feature interactions...")


def add_interactions(df):
    df = df.copy()

    # Define integer feature columns that likely interact with each other
    int_features = [
        "f_07",
        "f_08",
        "f_09",
        "f_10",
        "f_11",
        "f_12",
        "f_13",
        "f_14",
        "f_15",
        "f_16",
        "f_17",
        "f_18",
    ]

    # Create pairwise interactions for key features
    interaction_pairs = [
        ("f_07", "f_08"),
        ("f_07", "f_10"),
        ("f_07", "f_12"),
        ("f_08", "f_09"),
        ("f_08", "f_11"),
        ("f_08", "f_13"),
        ("f_09", "f_10"),
        ("f_10", "f_11"),
        ("f_11", "f_12"),
        ("f_12", "f_13"),
        ("f_13", "f_14"),
        ("f_14", "f_15"),
        ("f_07", "f_14"),
        ("f_08", "f_12"),
        ("f_09", "f_13"),
        ("f_10", "f_15"),
        ("f_11", "f_14"),
        ("f_07", "f_18"),
    ]

    for f1, f2 in interaction_pairs:
        interaction_name = f"{f1}_x_{f2}"
        df[interaction_name] = df[f1] * df[f2]

    # Add polynomial features for key numeric features
    poly_features = ["f_19", "f_20", "f_21", "f_22"]
    for f in poly_features:
        df[f + "_sq"] = df[f] ** 2
        df[f + "_cube"] = df[f] ** 3

    # Add ratio features for numeric pairs
    ratio_pairs = [
        ("f_00", "f_01"),
        ("f_02", "f_03"),
        ("f_04", "f_05"),
        ("f_06", "f_07"),
    ]

    for f1, f2 in ratio_pairs:
        ratio_name = f"{f1}_ratio_{f2}"
        df[ratio_name] = df[f1] / (df[f2] + 1e-10)

    return df


train_int = add_interactions(train)
test_int = add_interactions(test)

# Prepare features
train_id = train["id"]
test_id = test["id"]

target_col = "target"
features_to_drop = ["id", target_col]

X_train = train_int.drop(columns=features_to_drop)
y_train = train[target_col]
X_test = test_int.drop(columns=["id"])

print(f"Feature columns before: {len(X_train.columns)}")
print(f"Feature columns after: {len(X_test.columns)}")

# Identify categorical and numeric columns
cat_cols = X_train.select_dtypes(
    include=["object", "category", "string"]
).columns.tolist()
# Also include low-cardinality integer columns that are effectively categorical
low_cardinality_cols = X_train.select_dtypes(
    include=["int64", "int32", "int16", "int8"]
).columns.tolist()
cat_cols += [
    c for c in low_cardinality_cols if X_train[c].nunique() <= 10 and c not in cat_cols
]
cat_cols = list(set(cat_cols))

num_cols = X_train.select_dtypes(include=["float64", "float32"]).columns.tolist()

print(f"Categorical columns: {cat_cols}")
print(f"Numeric columns: {len(num_cols)}")

# Fit LabelEncoder on training data only - handle unseen categories safely
X_train_processed = X_train.copy()
X_test_processed = X_test.copy()

for col in cat_cols:
    enc = OrdinalEncoder(handle_unknown="use_encoded_value", unknown_value=-1)
    X_train_processed[col] = enc.fit_transform(
        X_train_processed[col].values.reshape(-1, 1)
    ).ravel()
    X_test_processed[col] = enc.transform(
        X_test_processed[col].values.reshape(-1, 1)
    ).ravel()

print("Feature engineering complete")

# LightGBM parameters - tuned for this task
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "learning_rate": 0.03,
    "feature_fraction": 0.85,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "min_child_weight": 0.001,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

# Split training data into train/validation (80/20) for proper hold-out evaluation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_processed, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Training set: {len(X_tr)} samples")
print(f"Validation set: {len(X_val)} samples")

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

# Train model
print("Training model...")
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    valid_names=["train", "valid"],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=100), lgb.log_evaluation(period=100)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
print("Evaluating on validation set...")
val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
print("Generating test predictions...")
test_pred = model.predict(X_test_processed, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)

# Create submission file with correct path
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_id.values, "target": test_pred})

# Save to submission directory (benchmark requirement)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission preview:\n{submission.head()}")
